# Arachnids
## General Information
Arachnids have [color=lightgreen]two extra pockets[/color] for item storage, crafted from their own silk.
Their fangs make their unarmed attacks deal [color=hotpink]Piercing[/color] damage.
Their animal-like digestive system can process [color=lightgreen]raw meat[/color] and [color=lightgreen]blood[/color] without ill effects. They are [color=orchid]poisoned[/color] by [color=orchid]allicin[/color] (found in garlic and onions) and [color=orchid]theobromine[/color] (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
Their blue blood is [color=deepskyblue]copper-based[/color], and can be replenished by metabolizing [color=deepskyblue]copper[/color], rather than iron.
They [color=#ffa500]suffocate 50% faster[/color] and [color=#ffa500]recover from Asphyxiation twice as slow[/color] as most species.
## Sericulture
Arachnids can create silk at the cost of getting hungrier. They can craft bundles of silk into clothing, shields, furniture, and even entire walls.
